The Primalist Future is a subset of the Temporal Conflux in southeast Thaldraszus, showing a potential future where the Primalists have won the war. Players initially visit the future during the Thaldraszus storyline quest To the Future! and direct follow-ups, seeking to restore the damage caused by Chromie and Eternus tumbling through the timeways and landing here. A rare elite world quest, Disrupting the Primalist Plan occasionally takes place here. Also, the Elemental Bound Chest event can rarely be found at in the northwest cave. Completing the scenario by fending off a few waves of enemies grants players the Chest of the Elements once a week. Added in patch 10.0.5, the Storm's Fury worl

Prince Tenris Mirkblood was introduced on October 22, 2008 as a part of the Scourge Invasion world event — which was itself a precursor to the release of Wrath of the Lich King. He could be found in Karazhan secluded in the Guardhouse, behind a Bloodstained Door above the stables where Attumen resides, which can be accessed through the stairs after Attumen, or through the ballroom where Moroes resides. His death is required to loot the papers which are the objective of the quest Chamber of Secrets. The Profanity Filter is an optional game mechanism which will cause all profanity (swear words, vulgarities, etc) in the chat box to be filtered and instead appear as a rackenfrax (random non-letter characters, such as @#^&$!).
Procs per minute (PPM) describes how a given proc mechanic functions. It is often used to contrast a game mechanic with one that uses "procs per hit" (PPH).

Prison Cell Key is used to open the prison doors that lead to Kharan Mighthammer, Marshal Windsor and Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. Private Hendel is a human former quest giver located just southwest of North Point Tower in Dustwallow Marsh. He was working with the Defias Brotherhood when King Varian Wrynn was kidnapped. After a series of tasks, he was captured by Lady Jaina and Archmage Tervosh. He is an ex-Kul Tiras marine.

Proenitus acts as one of the de facto leaders of the Crash Site and finds any way possible to help out in the current situation. In order to combat the depleted state of the available healing crystals, Proenitus actively seeks out Vale Moths in order to replenish the crystals using the blood of the moths. The recharged crystals are then handed off to the resident priest, Zalduun.

Pristine archaeology finds have a very slim chance to be created when solving common pandaren, mogu or mantid artifacts, beginning in Mists of Pandaria. The pristine version of the item starts a quest to put the item on permanent display at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms on Pandaria. The system was continued in Warlords of Draenor with arakkoa, Draenor clan and ogre artifacts. Once the player reaches level 100 and upgrades their garrison to Tier 3, they can display their pristine artifacts in the garrison's Town Hall.
